g.text: Cost comparison on identical, prespecified real-record blocks
Medians of five repeats; timing order alternates. Allocation profiling is separate from native timing. PSI histogram construction and shared scheduling are additional costs. These null-
block benchmarks use conservative early stopping and do not characterize every alternative. Whole offline study high-water RSS = 300.8 MiB, including retained frames/IDs. Histogram
payload is not total monitor memory. Full engine timings are retained separately.
